Blackstone Multi-Strategy Hedge Fund L.P. reported Thursday that it sold unregistered limited partnership units for total consideration of approximately $106.5 million. The sales were finalized after the calculation of the fund’s transactional net asset values as of September 30, 2026, according to a statement based on a SEC filing.

The sales occurred on October 1 and involved several classes of units. Specifically, the fund sold 347,135 Class I units for $8.85 million, 41,029 Class N units for $1.05 million, and 3,787,059 Class I-F units for $96.57 million. No sales were reported for Class S, Class D, or other classes during this period.

The offering was conducted as part of a continuous private placement to investors who qualify as both accredited investors under Regulation D of the Securities Act of 1933 and qualified purchasers under the Investment Company Act of 1940. The units were sold in reliance on exemptions from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D.

The fund also disclosed transactional net asset value (NAV) per unit for each class as of September 30, 2026. The NAV per unit was $25.48 for Class I, $25.46 for Class S, $25.47 for Class D and Class N, and $25.50 for Class I-F. No NAV was reported for Class S-F, D-F, or N-F units, but the initial NAV for these classes will match the Class I-F NAV at the time of their initial sale. As of September 30, 2026, the aggregate transactional NAV for the fund and related parallel vehicles was approximately $276.9 million.

The fund’s transactional NAV is used to determine the price for transactions in its units and may differ from net asset value calculated under generally accepted accounting principles.

Blackstone Multi-Strategy Hedge Fund L.P. does not have securities registered on any public exchange. The information is based on a press release statement and the company’s Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
